newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Stater Bros. Hldgs sells 144a notes.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Stater Bros. Hldgs sells 144a notes.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from Stater Bros. Holdings Inc was priced Monday via sole manager BankAmerica Securities Inc, according to a market source.
Stater Bros. Holdings headquartered in Colton, California, operates 110 supermarkets in the state of California.
TYPE SNR SUB NOTES ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 1/1/1998
LAST MOODY'S B2 YIELD 9.00 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P SINGLE-B SPREAD +277 BPS CALLABLE NON-CALL THREE
NOTE: The issue has a three-year equity call for 35 percent of the issue at 109.
